article.story: SMITHFIELD, R.I. -- — Keegan Harvey scored 20 points as Bryant began its season Monday with an 80-75 victory over Siena. Harvey added 12 rebounds for the Bulldogs. Duane Thompson added 14 points while going 4 for 10 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the line, and grabbed five rebounds. Onyx Nnani shot 4 for 14 from the field, including 1 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 13 points, while adding seven rebounds. Tim Ibukunoluwa finished with 20 points, 14 rebounds and two steals for the Saints. Siena also got 15 points, seven rebounds, eight assists and two steals from Pace Prosser. Trent Egbiremolen added 15 points, six rebounds and three steals. Up next Bryant plays at Quinnipiac on Thursday, and Siena hosts Princeton on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
